definitions.explanation: The act of maintaining order, enforcing rules, or supervising to ensure compliance with laws or regulations.
Intensified enforcement activity, especially by police or authorities against violations.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}が{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まりを{強化|きょうか}している。
examples.english: The police are intensifying their crackdown on drunk driving.

examples.japanese: {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}の{取|と}り{締|し}まりが{厳|きび}しくなった。
examples.english: Enforcement against illegal parking has become stricter.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}の{規律|きりつ}{取|と}り{締|し}まりを{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: I'm in charge of maintaining discipline within the company.

notes:
COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{取|と}り{締|し}まる (to control, supervise) → noun form {取|と}り{締|し}まり

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{取|と}り{締|し}まりを{行|おこな}う - to conduct enforcement
・{取|と}り{締|し}まりを{強化|きょうか}する - to intensify crackdowns
・{取|と}り{締|し}まりが{厳|きび}しい - enforcement is strict
・{取|と}り{締|し}まりに{遭|あ}う - to get caught in a crackdown
・{取|と}り{締|し}まりを{逃|のが}れる - to escape enforcement

TYPES OF {取|と}り{締|し}まり:
・{交通|こうつう}{取|と}り{締|し}まり - traffic enforcement
・{速度|そくど}{取|と}り{締|し}まり - speed enforcement
・{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり - crackdown on illegal dumping

RELATED TERM:
{取締役|とりしまりやく} - company director/board member (different meaning - uses the same kanji but refers to corporate governance role)

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Common in news reports and official announcements.
